title: Don Carter's Kirtland interdisciplinary groups with Kissinger
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: This guy Don Carter uh who was head of advanced research at Kirtland Air Force Base uh in 1962 is convening these interdisciplinary groups

plain: In 1962, a man named Don Carter, head of advanced research at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, was bringing together interdisciplinary groups of experts, groups that Michels links to Henry Kissinger. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in a conversation with the writer Greg Bishop, as part of a picture of quiet government thinking about the UFO question in the Kennedy years.
